channel.title: The Grant Desk - Fellowships, Writers, US, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Fellowships, Writers, US, weekly digest. Released weekly: the week's new grants arrive together on Sunday, one entry per grant plus a short roundup header, instead of trickling out daily. Each drop carries at most 10 grants, closest deadlines first; the rest follow the next Sunday.

item.description:

    https://www.nypl.org/about/fellowships-institutes/cullman-center-scholars-writers/fellowships

item.title: 2 new Writers fellowships - week of 18 May 2026
item.description:
• Alan Andres Writing Fellowships 2026-2027 (Boston Public Library)
    https://www.bpl.org/blogs/post/alan-andres-writing-fellowships-2026-2027-now-open-70k-bpl-residency-25k-fellowship-for-emerging-writers/
    Associates of the Boston Public Library · deadline Closed 05 Jun 2026 · Two fellowships (apply to only one): Writer-in-Residence: $70,000 stipend plus $2,500 editorial support and a year-long office residency at the Boston Public Library. Picture Book Writer Fellowship: $25,000 stipend plus $2,500 editorial support. No application fee.
  • Kate Medina Fellowship for Literary Narrative Nonfiction 2026 (NYPL)
    https://www.nypl.org/about/fellowships-institutes/kate-medina-fellowship-literary-narrative-nonfiction
    New York Public Library, in partnership with Random House · deadline Closed 15 Jun 2026 · $30,000 stipend for four continuous months of research (September 2026 to March 2027). No application fee.
